name: SP1 — Calls HTML report shows full prompts and responses

scenarios.name: FullContent-01 make_call_log_entry includes full content fields

steps.text: a call log entry is created with <field_name> <field_value>
the entry dict contains a "<field_name>" key
the <field_name> value equals <field_value>

scenarios.name: FullContent-04 log_llm_call stores full prompt text and response content

steps.text: an LLMResult with system_prompt "System instructions" and user_prompt "User task" and content '{"result": true}'
log_llm_call is invoked with the LLMResult
the appended calls.jsonl entry contains system_prompt_text "System instructions"
the appended calls.jsonl entry contains user_prompt_text "User task"
the appended calls.jsonl entry contains response_content containing "result"

scenarios.name: FullContent-05 log_llm_call_failure stores full prompt text

steps.text: log_llm_call_failure is invoked with system_prompt "System prompt" and user_prompt "User prompt" and error "timeout"
the appended calls.jsonl entry contains system_prompt_text "System prompt"
the appended calls.jsonl entry contains user_prompt_text "User prompt"

scenarios.name: FullContent-06 HTML report shows prompt content in collapsible sections

steps.text: a calls.jsonl file with an entry containing <field_name> <field_value>
the calls.jsonl file is rendered to HTML
the HTML contains the text <search_text>
the HTML contains a collapsible element for <collapsible_name>

scenarios.name: FullContent-08 HTML report shows response_content in collapsible section

steps.text: a calls.jsonl file with an entry containing response_content '{"gap_type": "missing_responsibility"}'
the calls.jsonl file is rendered to HTML
the HTML contains a collapsible element for response_content
the HTML contains the text "gap_type"

scenarios.name: FullContent-09 structured responses are pretty-printed as JSON

steps.text: a calls.jsonl file with an entry containing response_content '{"gap_type":"missing_responsibility","description":"test"}'
the calls.jsonl file is rendered to HTML
the HTML contains pretty-printed JSON with indentation
the HTML contains a pre-formatted block for the JSON content

scenarios.name: FullContent-10 unstructured responses shown in pre blocks

steps.text: a calls.jsonl file with an entry containing response_content 'This is a plain text response without JSON structure.'
the calls.jsonl file is rendered to HTML
the HTML contains a pre-formatted block with the response text
the HTML contains the text "This is a plain text response without JSON structure."

scenarios.name: FullContent-11 HTML report includes search and filter box

steps.text: a calls.jsonl file with entries for stages stage_1a and stage_2
the calls.jsonl file is rendered to HTML
the HTML contains a search or filter input element
the HTML contains JavaScript for filtering call entries
